name: Anonymous reservation requiring one-GiB alignment
required_postconditions: the returned reservation base is aligned to 1073741824 bytes

failure_sink.description: the case keeps mappings live until an ordinary successful mmap returns a base that is page-aligned but not one-GiB aligned

extraction_limitations: A single misaligned successful mapping is a counterexample to the claimed platform guarantee; the case makes up to 64 bounded attempts and does not implement over-allocation or trimming.
x_groundtruth: The mapping API promises host allocation-granularity alignment, not one GiB. This case observes the weaker legal outcome without changing the requested operation.
